```python
from itertools import product

def find_sequences():
    sequences = []
    # We limit the search to small sequences for efficiency
    for length in range(1, 6):  # Adjusted to smaller range for feasible computation
        for seq in product(range(length+1), repeat=length):
            if all(seq.count(j) == seq[j] for j in range(length)):
                sequences.append(seq)
                if len(sequences) == 10:  # Stop when we find 10 sequences
                    return sequences
    return sequences

result_sequences = find_sequences()
print(result_sequences)
```
